evidence_profile.assessed_benefit: Reinforcement attributable to the exact DE/EU serum alone under its verified intended protocol.
evidence_profile.supported_outcome: R03 attributes smoother/stronger hair over five washes to shampoo + conditioner + serum versus non-conditioning shampoo. This is a UK system result, not isolated-serum evidence for the unresolved DE/EU formula. E06 supplier result access is partial.
evidence_profile.stronger_claim_not_demonstrated: Isolated DE/EU serum strengthening, permanent bond rebuilding or equivalence to the supplier formulation.
evidence_profile.best_support_and_applicability: The UK source confirms the paired-marker candidate and overnight role. R14 does not verify the intended DE/EU formula; supplier identity/dose and overnight protocol equivalence are also unestablished.
evidence_profile.methods_and_comparator: The five-wash system versus non-conditioning shampoo cannot isolate the serum or named technology. E06's described 1% pH4 30-minute rinse experiment is not the overnight retail protocol and is not itself a retail efficacy result.
evidence_profile.contrary_and_counter_evidence: No decisive contrary retail efficacy test is supplied. E02 says the full hair-strengthening mechanism is unknown; generic proteins do not resolve it.

explanation_de.short: Die Zutatenliste und Nachtanwendung sind nur für die britische Version belegt. Die Zielrezeptur für DE/EU und die Einzelwirkung des Serums bleiben offen.
explanation_de.deep: Beide Marker sind in der UK-Liste vorhanden. Der beworbene Vergleich betrifft jedoch Shampoo, Conditioner und Serum zusammen gegenüber Shampoo ohne Pflegewirkung. Er belegt keine isolierte Serumwirkung. Dazu kommen unvollständig zugängliche Lieferantenergebnisse und die ungeklärte Marktversion. Persönliche Eignung und Katalogfreigabe sind damit nicht festgestellt.
